item.title: Bahrain: Three Killed, Including Child, In Traffic Accident Near Tree Of Life
item.description: A tragic traffic accident occurred on Friday in the Al-Qarah area of Sakhir, near the Tree of Life, resulting in the deaths of three people, including an eight-year-old child. According to initial information, the accident involved a collision between two vehicles while a group of people were on a recreational trip in the area. The incident led to multiple casualties. item.title: Up To 25% Of US Colleges May Close Soon, Brandeis President Warns
item.description: Higher education is approaching a period of profound disruption, and many colleges may not survive, Arthur Levine, the newly appointed president of Brandeis University, said during a recent event. item.title: Trump Says US ‘Armada’ Moving Towards Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he is sending an “armada” towards Iran, threatening Tehran against resuming its nuclear program. Speaking to reporters aboard Air Force One after returning from meetings with world leaders in Davos, Switzerland, Trump said Washington was closely monitoring Iran as US naval assets moved into the region. “We have a lot of ships going that direction, just in case,” Trump said. “I’d rather not see anything happen, but we’re watching them very closely.”

item.title: Saudi Arabia deports more than 14,000 illegal expats in one week
item.description: Saudi Arabia has arrested more than 18,000 people in a week-long nationwide campaign targeting violations of residency, labour and border security laws. The Ministry of Interior said the joint field campaigns, carried out across all regions between January 15 and January 21, resulted in the arrest of 18,200 violators. item.title: Bahrain: Free Wi-Fi Now Available For All Travelers At King Fahd Causeway
item.description: For a more convenient travel experience, all travelers at King Fahd Causeway can now enjoy free Wi-Fi in the departure and processing areas. This service aims to make the journey smoother and keep passengers connected at all times.

item.description: Bahrain’s Council of Representatives will discuss next Tuesday a Shura Council–proposed draft law aimed at strengthening rules for licensing and managing childcare nurseries under the Child Law.
